## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser-based 3D mobile racing game inspired by Need for Speed, designed for landscape phone/tablet play.

## Requirements
- Include 35 levels: 1–5 city, 6–10 forest, 11–25 mountains, 26–30 night city, and 31–35 port; varied challenges, police chases, and a one-on-one rival race at level 35.
- Include a garage for car purchases and upgrades, music/sound settings, general options, and mobile throttle, brake, left, and right controls.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a Three.js browser game with procedural 3D environments and synthesized audio.
- Added keyboard controls alongside touch controls; progression, credits, cars, and upgrades use local storage.
- Added a dedicated nitro control after discovering boost previously required holding both steering controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the core game UI and logic in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`: menus, 35 levels, environments, garage, settings, race HUD, touch/keyboard controls, upgrades, police pursuits, and level 35 rival encounter.

- Fixed the pause button being blocked by the brand overlay with `pointer-events:none` on `.top-brand`.
- Added an inline SVG favicon to `index.html` to address the observed favicon 404.
- `node --check game.js` passed before the latest edits.

- Finish and verify nitro input wiring: `input.nitro` and `boostActive=input.nitro&&input.throttle&&boost>0` are in place, the touch control map includes nitro, and `index.html` includes a nitro button.
- Check keyboard controls, especially `Space` mapping to nitro; the attempted replacement failed because the key mapping appears twice in `game.js` (keydown and keyup).
- Rerun syntax and browser validation after edits.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update both keyboard mappings in `game.js` so Space activates nitro on keydown and resets on keyup; verify input release behavior.
2. Add/verify CSS styling and responsive placement for the new `.nitro` control.
3. Run `node --check game.js`, verify race controls and nitro in Playwright, then inspect `git status --short`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, race controls, screens, inline favicon.
- `style.css`: Game layout, responsive landscape styling, race controls.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, levels, game logic, garage, audio, and input.

- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` lists untracked `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css`.
